name: Gradient-Based Interpolation by Sample Splatting
definition: A real-time interpolation algorithm that reconstructs source radiance $L_x$ throughout a volume from a small set of samples, using both radiance values and radiance gradients to achieve higher accuracy than standard interpolation.
summary: Gradient-Based Interpolation by Sample Splatting reconstructs source radiance in inhomogeneous media using radiance and spatial gradients to reduce artifacts while maintaining real-time performance.
